text: [angry, fast] Two defeats in a row, and our kids are carrying the worst signing!
Liverpool lose three-two in Istanbul. One question. Barcola... flop, or give him time?
[passionate, raised voice] Give the lad time! He got a hat-trick last month. You don't forget how to play in four weeks.
[tired, grumbling] I've watched Liverpool since the eighties. Over a hundred million, and Nyoni is doing more than him.
[laughing in disbelief] I left my wife's birthday party for this! [laughs] Send him back to PSG. I want a refund too.
[calm, firm] Neither. He's a winger. Stop playing him up front and you'll see the real Barcola.
Flop, or give him time? You tell us.
